allocation: Recorded allocator checks memory.used<512MiB. This threshold alone is not proof of exclusive GPU ownership or an atomic reservation across independent allocators.
costs: The receipts measure real evidence-preparation phases. Shared teacher loads, warm image caches and fixed input-variant order are explicit. These times are not fair isolated per-policy end-to-end deployment benchmarks.
nested_time: Backend forward_seconds is inside service wall time and must not be added again.
future_retained_method_benchmark: Match evidence/features/resources and include student+teacher startup/extraction/adaptation/recomputation, inference and output. Capture actual compute-process allocation, then report cold and any justified shared-service/warm scenario separately. Do not replace missing whole-method costs with these pilots.
